fieldData.description: Durante l'incontro verranno sorteggiati gadget ed altri piccoli regali per i partecipanti. Evento gratuito aperto a chi conosce già Radix DLT ma soprattutto a chi deve ancora muovere i primi passi in questa straordinaria tecnologia che va oltre il mondo delle blockchain. An aperitif to get to know each other and share knowledge. (During the meeting gadgets and other small gifts for the participants will be raffled off. Free event open to those who already know about Radix DLT but above all to those who have yet to take their first steps in this extraordinary technology that goes far beyond the world of blockchains.) For more information please contact the Event Ambassador @Michelinux via the Telegram Meetup Channel. https://t.me/Radix_Meetup.
fieldData.location: Dasein Pane & Champagne Via Lodovico Settala, 2n01 20124 Milano Italy
